latest_release.name: v1.40.3
latest_release.body:
**Enhance**
- Requires `modelscope-hub>=0.7.0`.
- New `modelscope.utils.file_utils.get_hub_cache_root()`; `modelscope.hub.cache_manager` re-exports `get_cache_root` and `resolve_cached_snapshot`. `MS_CACHE_HOME` is normalised to an absolute path when bridged into the hub config.

**Fix**
- `model_file_download(..., local_files_only=True)` no longer calls the API to resolve the default revision, so offline downloads from cache work without network access or credentials.
- `ms clear-cache` lists every resolved target before deleting and delegates to modelscope-hub's scoped cache APIs; cache deletion via `FileSystemCache` goes through the same validated removal, refusing empty identifiers, path traversal, out-of-root targets and symlinked paths.
- `update_local_model` no longer copies models that already live under the legacy model root or the modelscope-hub cache root.
- Hugging Face patch: `hf_hub_download` translates missing files to `EntryNotFoundError` and cache misses to `LocalEntryNotFoundError`, so callers relying on Hugging Face exception types keep working.
- `modelscope.hub.snapshot_download` exports `InvalidParameter` again, preserving the shim module's exception contract.

**Docs**
- Docstrings for the legacy cache-path helpers now state that they describe the legacy layout only and point to `get_hub_cache_root()`, `snapshot_download()` and `resolve_cached_snapshot()`.

## What's Changed
* Offline Download & Cache Cleanup Fixes by @wangxingjun778 in https://github.com/modelscope/modelscope/pull/1844


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/modelscope/modelscope/compare/v1.40.2...v1.40.3
